description: Food Expenditure Series is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The series measures food spending and acquisitions by product, outlet and purchaser. Its stated coverage is United States; long-term national expenditure series. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed CSV, XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Money spent is not a physical measure of freight or calories delivered. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
